reviews.text: ENTERFelipeho jsem si prvně všiml v Eric Andre Show, kde nahradil Hannibala jako co-host, ale i protože je jeho přítomnost skoupá na slovo, o to záživnější je pak poslouchat, jak rozjíždí stand-up hned od začátku, co chvíli tam byl nějakej LOL joke, jen takový tlachání, ale samý dobrý hlody: "I wrote him back and I said, listen, man, I don't feel comfortable to bringing all that bad luck to my show, bro. Yea, man, I don't think God is finished with you." (...) "I don't have a long penis, I just have a lotta foreskin, you know. But not enough dick to fill it all up. When I get a hard on, it looks like a sweater with short arms. Like, I don't fuck. I paint. They call me Pablo Pitazo. Eee, Jackson Pollock." (...) "It's allright, guys. If you don't have a big penis, women don't care about that. Okay, maybe two women, man. Women want just a good-looking man. A good-looking man they could brag about. You know? When you have an ugly man you only mention his qualities when people ask you. So how is Ruben? Now, he's a hard worker, let me tell you. Seventy hours a week. We never see his ugly ass. He knows how to provide for kids that aren't his, you know? But when you have a hot man, you let everybody know. "So how is Fabien?" "I don't know, but I can still feel him inside of me right now. Like he must have punctured a lung or ripped one of my rib cages. All right, he can't read, but he has a big-ass dick. He leaves me stupid sometimes. Gotta fuck him holding my purse. That fool tried to rob me last time." (...) "Hey, bro, who's that crazy guy?" "Oh, it's my uncle Twilight Zone, bro." (...) "I thought you were taking jiujitsu classes on YouTube." (...) "When you watch that... the shows like Narcos on Netflix or Griselda, there's always a bunch of hot chicks having orgies, threesomes. Those are lies. I've never done that with women. The women I party with party like this: *snorts cocaine* "Oh my God! Who's gonna pick up my kids from school now?" (...) Yeah, man. I walked in on my mom and dad having sex... when I was 35 years old. It feels like yesterday. I came into the house. I kept hearing h-h-h-h-h ch-ch-ch-ch h-h-h-h-h ch-ch-ch-ch. My father breathing hard and his car keys shaking. I looked down on my mom. She looked sad, looking at me. "I grew up in different times, mijo." (...) "And this old lady, she was throwing her food away. And she dumped all her fries on my plate. She said, "You look like you can finish these fries." I was like. "Lucky guess, bitch!" I remember somebody stole my identity, man, ten years ago. And they got arrested for my warrant. I remember he was calling me, "Hey, man, tell 'em that's you."(15.05.2025)
